tags.name: MediaService
tags.description:
MediaService stores the files people upload: driver documents, profile and
address photos, support attachments.

A file never passes through the backend. The app asks CreateUpload for a
short-lived signed URL, sends the bytes straight to the object store with it,
then calls CompleteUpload. Only then is the file checked (size, real type from
its bytes, image dimensions); images are re-encoded, which drops their metadata
(camera, GPS position) and anything hidden in them. A file that fails is
deleted and REJECTED.

Files are private. They are read through GetDownloadURL (a signed URL valid a
few minutes): by their owner, by staff with media.read, or by a service.

tags.name: StaffService
tags.description:
StaffService owns who works on the platform (operators, finance, support),
what each of them may do, and the audit trail of what they did.

Staff sign in like everyone else, through identity-service (an email OTP).
Identity only proves who they are; the roles and permissions here decide what
they may do. Every admin RPC in any service asks AuthorizeStaffAction first,
which records the attempt before it runs.

get.summary: ListAuditEntries lists what staff did, newest first. Needs audit.read.

parameters.name: actorStaffId
parameters.description: Optional filters.

get.summary:
Staff with zones.manage (or the internal token) manage cities; the admin
list includes inactive ones. Switching a city off stops serving all its
zones at once.

ListDrivers lists drivers for the review queue and the admin, newest first,
optionally by status. Staff with drivers.read, or the internal token.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Optional filter.

 - DRIVER_STATUS_PENDING: Registered, waiting for an operator to review the driver.
 - DRIVER_STATUS_REJECTED: Reviewed and turned down by an operator.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The next_page_token of the previous page; empty for the first page.

post.summary:
ApproveDriver moves a PENDING (or REJECTED) driver to ACTIVE. Staff with
drivers.approve, or the internal token. A driver can never approve themselves.

RejectDriver moves a PENDING driver to REJECTED, with the reason the driver
is shown. Staff with drivers.approve, or the internal token.

get.summary: ListPermissions lists every permission a role can grant. Needs staff.read.

Staff with places.manage (or the internal token) manage curated places;
the admin list includes inactive ones.

Rate cards (staff, pricing.manage). A card applies to a zone, a city or
everywhere, for one vehicle class or all of them; the most specific one
prices a trip: zone, then city, then everywhere, and within each a
class's own card before the one for all classes. Setting a card adds a
new version, so what past fares were priced with stays on file.

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description:
Optional filters: only cards for this city (and its zones' cards are not
included), or only this zone's.

post.summary:
RetireRateCard removes a zone's or city's card (or a class's card
everywhere), so trips there fall back to the next one. The card for
every class everywhere cannot be retired.

get.summary: ListRoles lists system and custom roles. Needs staff.read.

post.summary: CreateRole adds a custom role. Needs roles.manage, and every permission it grants.

delete.summary: DeleteRole removes a custom role nobody holds. Needs roles.manage.

patch.summary:
UpdateRole renames a custom role or changes its permissions. System roles
cannot change. Needs roles.manage, and every permission added or removed.

get.summary: ListStaffMembers lists staff, optionally by status. Needs staff.read.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Optional filter.

 - STAFF_STATUS_INVITED: Invited, waiting for the person to sign in and accept.
 - STAFF_STATUS_REVOKED: An invitation cancelled before it was accepted.

post.summary:
InviteStaffMember invites an email address with a set of roles. Needs
staff.manage, and every permission the roles grant.

get.summary: GetStaffMember reads one staff member. Needs staff.read.

put.summary:
SetStaffRoles replaces a staff member's roles. Needs staff.manage, and
every permission of the roles added or removed.

post.summary: ReactivateStaffMember lifts a suspension. Needs staff.manage.
RevokeStaffInvite cancels an invitation that was not accepted yet. Needs staff.manage.
SuspendStaffMember blocks an active staff member at once. Needs staff.manage.

get.summary:
Surge rules by the hour (staff, pricing.manage), read in the local time
of the city the pickup is in.

A surge staff put on one zone for a while (a concert, a storm), on top
of what the hour and the demand add (staff, pricing.manage).

parameters.name: zoneId
parameters.description: Optional: one zone's.

parameters.name: includePast
parameters.description: Also the ones that are over (the latest 100).

post.summary:
Service zones — the geographic areas the platform actually serves,
down to arbitrary polygons (not just a city name). See
CheckServiceZone for the query every trip request must pass.
CreateZone, UpdateZone and SetZoneActive change the served map: staff with
zones.manage, or the internal token.

parameters.name: cohortWeeks
parameters.description: how many weeks back to include

parameters.name: cohortWeeks
parameters.description: how many weeks back to include

post.summary: Logout ends the session of the refresh token in the body. Public: that token is the credential.
LogoutAllSessions ends every session of the identity the refresh token belongs to. Public.
RequestLoginOTP sends a one-time code to a phone number or email. Public: no token.
VerifyLoginOTP exchanges the code for an access token and a refresh token. Public: no token.
RefreshToken rotates the token pair. Public: the refresh token in the body is the credential.

get.summary:
Cities the platform operates in. Every service zone and curated place
belongs to one; its time zone is the one schedules and reports use.
ListCities and GetCity show active cities to any signed-in user.

post.summary: RegisterDevice registers a push token for the caller's own rider or driver profile.

UnregisterDevice removes a push token the caller owns. The token travels in the body: push tokens
contain ':' which cannot appear in a URL path segment.

CreateDriver creates the caller's own driver profile: identity_id must be the caller's identity.
The new driver starts PENDING and cannot go online until an operator approves it.

get.summary: GetDriver returns the caller's own driver profile.

patch.summary: UpdateDriverProfile changes the caller's own driver profile and vehicle.

put.summary:
UpdateAvailability goes online or offline; only the driver themselves may.
A PENDING or REJECTED driver may only be offline (FAILED_PRECONDITION otherwise).

get.summary:
GetPendingOffer is the Driver app's poll target: the trip it is being offered,
with what it needs to decide (where from and to, vehicle class, payment method,
when the offer ends), or NOT_FOUND when there is none. It does not say who the
rider is. driver_id must be the caller's own driver profile.

post.summary: RequestPayout withdraws from the driver's own wallet; idempotency_key makes a retry safe.

get.summary: CheckDriverStanding tells a driver whether they can take trips and how much to deposit if not.

post.summary:
RecordTripChange is how a driver reports that the rider handed over more cash than the
trip's cash part and there was no change to give back: the difference is credited to the
rider's wallet. The driver sends only cash_received (all the cash handed over); the change
is worked out here. The platform pays: nothing is taken from the driver. Only the trip's
own driver, after the trip is settled, once per trip (the same amount again is harmless),
and at most the deployment's max_change_credit.
EstimateFare quotes a trip for the caller: rider_id must be the caller's own rider profile.

QuoteTrip prices a trip for every vehicle class at once, with how far
the nearest free driver of each class is. Each quote holds its price for
a few minutes: a trip requested with its quote_id pays exactly that.
rider_id must be the caller's own rider profile.

get.summary: GetDriverByIdentity finds the caller's driver profile from their identity id.
GetRiderByIdentity finds the caller's rider profile from their identity id.

GetLocation is the rider app's poll target for a driver's live
position during an active trip (entity_type=ENTITY_TYPE_DRIVER).
entity_type isn't in the path because grpc-gateway can't bind an
enum's string value there reliably — it comes through as a normal
query param (?entity_type=ENTITY_TYPE_DRIVER) instead.

put.summary: UpdateLocation reports the caller's own position (driver app, every few seconds).

get.summary: GetMyIdentity returns the caller's identity id, status and verified identifiers.

post.summary: VerifyIdentifierLinkOTP completes linking with the code.
RequestIdentifierLinkOTP starts linking a phone or email to the caller's identity.
VerifyIdentifierUnlinkOTP completes removing it with the code.
RequestIdentifierUnlinkOTP starts removing a phone or email from the caller's identity.

get.summary: ListMySessions lists the caller's sessions (device, address, last seen).

delete.summary: RevokeSession ends one of the caller's sessions.

get.summary: GetMedia reads a file's details. Its owner, staff with media.read, or a service.

delete.summary: DeleteMedia removes the caller's own file, unless a service holds it.

post.summary: CompleteUpload checks the uploaded bytes and makes the file READY or REJECTED.

get.summary: GetDownloadURL returns a short-lived URL to read a READY file.

post.summary: CreateUpload reserves a file of a purpose and returns where to PUT it.

get.summary: ListNotifications returns the caller's own inbox; recipient_type and recipient_id are query parameters.

post.summary: MarkAsRead marks notifications of the caller's own inbox as read.

get.summary:
Curated places: airports, malls, hotels... that staff chose, named in
every language, with the exact point to be picked up or dropped at.
SearchPlaces lists matching curated places before map results.
ListPlaces and GetPlace show active places to any signed-in user.

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description: Optional filters.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: At most 100; 20 by default.

get.summary: ReverseGeocode names what is at a point. Any signed-in user may ask.

SearchPlaces finds places (a mall, a street, a neighbourhood) by name, best match
first. Any signed-in user may ask.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What to look for; 2 to 200 characters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many places to return: 5 by default, at most 10.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description:
The language names are given in: "ar", "ku" or "en". Empty means Arabic, then
Kurdish, then English.

post.summary: CreateRider creates the caller's own rider profile: identity_id must be the caller's identity.

get.summary: GetRider returns the caller's own rider profile.

patch.summary: UpdateRiderProfile changes the caller's own rider profile.

post.summary:
Saved addresses: the caller's own home, work and other places, with what
helps the captain find them (building, floor, a note, a photo). At most 20,
one home and one work. Services (trip-service, with the internal token)
read them when a trip is requested from one.

get.summary:
ListRecentDestinations lists where the rider's completed trips ended,
most recent first, each place once.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 5 by default, at most 10.

post.summary:
GetRoute returns the best route by road between two points: how far, how long, and
the line to draw on a map. Any signed-in user may ask.

get.summary:
GetMyStaffProfile returns the caller's staff record, roles and effective
permissions. NOT_FOUND when the caller is not staff.

post.summary:
AcceptStaffInvite binds the caller's identity to the invitation sent to one
of the caller's verified email addresses, and activates it.

get.summary:
ListTrips is the caller's trip history, newest first, one page at a time. Name
exactly one of rider_id and driver_id, and it must be the caller's own profile.
Pass the previous page's next_page_token to get the following page; an empty
next_page_token means that was the last one.

parameters.name: riderId
parameters.description: Exactly one of the two, and it must be the caller's own profile.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: 1 to 50, default 20; a larger value is served as 50.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: The next_page_token of the previous page; empty for the first page.

get.summary:
GetTrip is the rider/driver app's poll target for live trip status —
both the Rider app's tracking screen and the Driver app's active-trip
screen call this every few seconds until they see the status they're
waiting for (ACCEPTED, then IN_PROGRESS, then COMPLETED).

GetTripDriver is how the rider's app shows who is driving: the driver's name, car,
plate and rating. Only the rider of the trip may ask, and only once a driver has
accepted (FAILED_PRECONDITION before that). It has no phone number, no identity and
nothing about the driver's account.

GetDriverLocation is the Rider app's live-tracking poll target: where the
driver of this trip last reported being. Only the trip's rider may ask, and
only while the trip is ACCEPTED or IN_PROGRESS (FAILED_PRECONDITION
otherwise). It returns the position and when the driver reported it, and
nothing else about the driver. NOT_FOUND means the driver has not reported
recently (a live position expires after 30 seconds); the app keeps polling.

GetTripPath returns every waypoint recorded for a trip, oldest
first — the reconstructed route for a completed trip, or the route
so far for one still in progress (e.g. right after an SOS alert).

GetPickupPhoto gives a short-lived link to the photo of the saved pickup
address, to the rider and the driver of the trip while it is accepted or
in progress.

post.summary:
AcceptOffer makes the caller the driver of the trip: the offer and the trip
change together (the trip goes from REQUESTED to ACCEPTED). NOT_FOUND: there
is no live offer of this trip to this driver. FAILED_PRECONDITION: the offer
expired, the trip was cancelled meanwhile, or the driver is on another trip.
driver_id must be the caller's own driver profile.

RateTrip is how one side rates the other after a trip: the rider rates the driver and
the driver rates the rider. rated_by names who is speaking and must be the caller's
own side of that trip. Only a COMPLETED trip, within 24 hours of completing, once per
side (ALREADY_EXISTS the second time, which an app can treat as done). Stars are whole
numbers from 1 to 5; the comment is optional (500 characters at most) and is kept for
the operating company only: the person rated never sees it.

RejectOffer declines the offer; the trip goes on to the next driver, and this
driver is not offered it again. driver_id must be the caller's own profile.

TriggerSOS records a safety alert during an active trip — it does
NOT replace calling emergency services directly (the app's SOS
button dials the local emergency number itself); this is the
platform-side record: what trip, who pressed it, and where, so the
safety team can pull up the trip (and its path, via GetTripPath)
immediately and a notification goes out to the configured safety
contact.

RecordWaypoint appends one point to the trip's path. Called by the
driver app on a timer (every ~15-30s) alongside — not instead of —
its regular LocationService.UpdateLocation ping; the two are
independent so a failure in one never blocks the other. Duplicate
calls inside the throttle window are silently absorbed, so the
caller doesn't need its own client-side timing logic.

get.summary:
GetActiveTrip is how an app finds the trip it should be showing: the caller's
requested, accepted or in-progress trip, for example when the app is opened
again after being closed. Name exactly one of rider_id and driver_id, and it
must be the caller's own profile. NOT_FOUND means there is no active trip.

parameters.name: riderId
parameters.description: Exactly one of the two, and it must be the caller's own profile.

post.summary:
InitiateTopUp starts a ZainCash-funded top-up for a driver: creates
a pending record and opens a ZainCash payment session, returning
the URL the driver's browser/webview should be sent to.

ProcessZainCashWebhook receives ZainCash's server-to-server payment
notification. Called directly by ZainCash, not by an authenticated
platform client — exempted from the auth interceptor same as the
health check (see authentication_interceptor.go).

get.summary: GetWallet returns the caller's own wallet: ?owner_type=OWNER_TYPE_RIDER or OWNER_TYPE_DRIVER.
ListTransactions lists the caller's own wallet history: ?owner_type=&limit=.

GetTripSettlement tells how a settled trip's fare was paid: what left the rider's
wallet and how much cash the driver collects. ?owner_type=&owner_id= is the caller's
own wallet, and only the rider and the driver of the trip can read it (anyone else,
like a trip that is not settled yet, gets NOT_FOUND). A driver also sees the
commission and their earning; a rider does not.
ListZones lists service zones, optionally for one city (?city_id=).

parameters.name: cityId
parameters.description: Optional. Empty returns zones for every city.

get.summary: GetZone reads one service zone.
CheckServiceZone tells whether a point is served (?coordinates.latitude=&coordinates.longitude=).

reason.description: Shown to the driver. Optional for the internal token, required for staff.

LocationServiceUpdateCityBody.description:
UpdateCity replaces the name, the translations, the time zone and the
center.

LocationServiceUpdatePlaceBody.description: UpdatePlace replaces everything but the city.

PricingServiceUpdateSurgeRuleBody.description: Replaces the rule's label, days, hours and percent (not where it applies).

photoMediaId.description:
Optional: a READY upload of the caller's with purpose ADDRESS_PHOTO. It is
then kept by the address (the owner can no longer delete it on its own) and
deleted with it.

RiderServiceUpdateSavedAddressBody.description:
UpdateSavedAddress replaces kind, label, coordinates, address, details and
note. The photo changes only when photo_media_id is set (the old one is
deleted) or remove_photo is true.

ratedBy.description: Who is rating: the rider (rating the driver) or the driver (rating the rider).

comment.description:
Optional, at most 500 characters. Kept for the operating company; never shown to the
person rated.

cashReceived.description: Decimal string: all the cash the rider handed over for this trip.

outcomeCode.description: gRPC status code name the action ended with (OK, NotFound, ...).

v1AuditOutcome.description: - AUDIT_OUTCOME_PENDING: Allowed, and the service has not reported how it ended (yet).

canTakeTrips.description: False means: assign no trips to this driver at all.

suspensionThreshold.description: Balance at or below which the account is suspended (negative or zero).

amountDue.description:
How much the driver must deposit to get back above the threshold.
Zero when they are in good standing.

v1CheckDriverStandingResponse.description:
A driver works on a prepaid commission balance: they deposit money up
front, commission is drawn from it, and once the balance falls to the
suspension threshold their account stops receiving trips entirely
until they top up again.

zoneId.description:
Only set when served is true. A point is served when an active zone of an
active city covers it.

timeZone.description: The city's IANA time zone, for example "Asia/Baghdad".

name.description: The name used when no translation fits.

names.description: The name in other languages, by language: "ar", "ku", "en".

center.description: Where a map of the city opens.

sizeBytes.description: The exact size of the file; the upload URL only accepts that many bytes.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file here, with exactly the headers below.

cityId.description: The city the zone is in (see CreateCity).

startsAt.description: From now unless set; up to 7 days ahead.

name.description: The name used when no translation fits.

names.description: The name in other languages, by language: "ar", "ku", "en".

address.description: A short address or directions ("Main gate, 100m Street").

coordinates.description: The exact point to be picked up or dropped at (a gate, an entrance).

priority.description: Higher first, in lists and search.

rejectionReason.description: Why the last review turned the driver down; empty unless REJECTED.

v1DriverStatus.description:
- DRIVER_STATUS_PENDING: Registered, waiting for an operator to review the driver.
 - DRIVER_STATUS_REJECTED: Reviewed and turned down by an operator.

zoneId.description:
The service zone the pickup resolved to — set even when that
zone has no rate card of its own and pricing fell back to the
deployment's global default.

vehicleClass.description: The vehicle class this fare was priced for.

minimumFareAdjustment.description:
What was added to bring base + distance + duration up to the rate
card's minimum fare; included in subtotal.

cityId.description: The city the pickup is in.

v1FareBreakdown.description:
Money fields are decimal strings (e.g. "2451.6"), never double —
float64 in protobuf would reintroduce exactly the precision problem
the underlying NUMERIC columns exist to avoid (same convention as
wallet.proto). distance_km/duration_minutes stay double: physical
measurements from OSRM, not currency.

updatedAt.description: When the driver's phone last reported this position.

permissions.description: Empty unless the staff member is active.

polyline.description:
The whole path as a Google encoded polyline with 5 digits of precision (about a
metre), ready to decode and draw.

fareAmount.description: Decimal strings, like every money field.

cashAmount.description: What the rider hands the driver in cash.

commissionAmount.description: Only filled for the driver's own view.

changeAmount.description: The change credited to the rider's wallet because the driver had none. "0" if none.

rateCards.description: The card in force for each place and class.

addresses.description: Home, then work, then the others by label.

notificationIds.description: When empty, marks every unread notification for this recipient.

contentType.description: What is stored, once READY (a WebP photo is stored as JPEG).

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes, once READY.

held.description: A service holds it: the owner cannot delete it.

v1MediaPurpose.description:
- MEDIA_PURPOSE_DRIVER_DOCUMENT: Licence, vehicle papers, ID: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.
 - MEDIA_PURPOSE_PROFILE_PHOTO: A rider's or driver's picture: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
 - MEDIA_PURPOSE_ADDRESS_PHOTO: A photo that helps the captain find a saved address: up to 8 MB.
 - MEDIA_PURPOSE_SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT: Attached to a support ticket: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.

v1MediaStatus.description:
- MEDIA_STATUS_PENDING: Reserved, waiting for the bytes and CompleteUpload.
 - MEDIA_STATUS_REJECTED: The bytes failed the checks; the object was deleted.
 - MEDIA_STATUS_EXPIRED: Never completed in time; the reservation was dropped.

id.description:
The OpenStreetMap object, for example "way/123456", or "curated/<id>" for
a curated place.

name.description:
The short name (a mall, a street) and the full one with neighbourhood, city and
country.

address.description:
The parts of the address that are known (road, neighbourhood, suburb, city, state,
postcode...), by OpenStreetMap's own names.

curatedPlaceId.description:
Set for a curated place (see CuratedPlace): its id, and category is then
the curated category in lower case ("airport", "mall"...).

token.description: The raw JWT ZainCash sends (their "token" field).

quotes.description: One per vehicle class, cheapest class first.

zoneId.description: Where it applies: a zone, a city, or everywhere (both empty). Never both.

vehicleClass.description: economy or comfort; empty for every class.

minimumFare.description: The least a trip costs before surge and discounts.

freeWaitingMinutes.description:
Minutes a driver waits at the pickup for free, then the price of each
further minute.

cancellationFee.description:
What a rider pays for cancelling once cancellation_grace_minutes have
passed since a driver accepted, and for not showing up.

maxSurgePercent.description: The most surge can add, in percent (0 turns surge off).

demandSurge.description: Whether demand near the pickup and the weather add surge.

createdBy.description: The staff member's identity id; empty for the starting card.

v1RateCard.description: Money fields are decimal strings in the deployment's currency.

address.description: As the rider picked it; may be empty for trips from before addresses.

cashDue.description: The cash part of the fare, what the rider handed over, and the difference credited.

v1RecordWaypointResponse.description:
Empty on purpose: a throttled-away duplicate and a freshly recorded
point both succeed identically — the caller doesn't need to
distinguish them, so there's nothing worth returning either way.

paymentMethod.description: cash (default when empty) or wallet. card is not supported yet.

pickupAddress.description:
The addresses as the rider picked them ("Family Mall, Erbil"); at most
300 characters each. Taken from the saved address when one is named.

pickupSavedAddressId.description:
One of the rider's saved addresses: its point, address, details, note
for the captain and photo are copied into the trip.

quoteId.description:
A quote from pricing-service QuoteTrip that is the rider's and has not
expired or been used. The trip keeps its price, and is for its vehicle
class; pickup and dropoff (or the saved addresses) must be within 50
metres of the quoted points.

cohortWeek.title: YYYY-MM-DD of the cohort's week-start Monday

key.description: Stable name used in code for system roles (owner, operations); empty for custom roles.

label.description: Required for OTHER; optional otherwise. At most 60 characters.

coordinates.description: The exact point to be picked up or dropped at.

address.description: The address as shown ("Gulan Street, Erbil"); at most 300 characters.

details.description: Building, floor, apartment; at most 200 characters.

noteForDriver.description: For the captain ("Blue gate, ring twice"); at most 300 characters.

photoMediaId.description: A photo of the entrance (media-service, purpose ADDRESS_PHOTO), or empty.

v1SavedAddressKind.description:
- SAVED_ADDRESS_KIND_HOME: At most one of each per rider.
 - SAVED_ADDRESS_KIND_OTHER: Needs a label ("Gym", "Mum's").

identityId.description: Empty until the invitation is accepted.

v1StaffStatus.description:
- STAFF_STATUS_INVITED: Invited, waiting for the person to sign in and accept.
 - STAFF_STATUS_REVOKED: An invitation cancelled before it was accepted.

zonePercent.description: A surge staff put on the pickup's zone.

label.description:
What staff called the surge that applies (a rule's label or a zone
surge's reason), for the app to show; empty when none does.

v1SurgeBreakdown.description:
SurgeBreakdown makes each contributing factor visible instead of just a
final multiplier — useful for support/debugging ("why was my fare
higher") and for the rider-facing app to show "+20% due to demand".
Percent/multiplier fields are decimal strings, not double — they feed
directly into fare math (see FareBreakdown below) and float64 would
reintroduce the same rounding drift the decimal fare fields exist to
avoid.

total_percent = the larger of time_of_day_percent and zone_percent (both
set by staff; they never add up) + demand_percent + weather_percent,
capped by the rate card's max_surge_percent.

zoneId.description: Where it applies: a zone, a city, or everywhere (both empty).

dayOfWeek.description: 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday; unset for every day.

startTime.description:
Local time in the city, "HH:MM". A window that ends before it starts
runs past midnight (23:00 to 04:00).

amount.description: Signed decimal string: negative means money left the wallet.

v1TransactionType.description: - TRANSACTION_TYPE_CHANGE_CREDIT: Change the driver could not return in cash, credited to the rider's wallet.

pickupDetails.description:
Copied from the saved pickup address: building/floor, and the note for
the captain.

hasPickupPhoto.description: The saved pickup address has a photo: GetPickupPhoto gives a link.

quoteId.description:
The fare quote the trip was requested with (pricing-service QuoteTrip),
and the price it fixed: a decimal string in currency_code. All three are
empty for a trip requested without a quote, which is priced when it
completes.

expiresAt.description: The last moment the driver can accept.

quotedFare.description: The quoted price, when the trip has one (a decimal string).

v1TripOffer.description: TripOffer is what a driver sees to decide. The rider is not identified.

expiresAt.description: Request the trip before this; after it, ask for a new quote.

driversAvailable.description:
Whether a free driver of this class is near the pickup right now, and
how many minutes away the nearest one is by road (0 when unknown).

balance.description:
Decimal string (e.g. "2451.6") — never a float, to avoid any
precision loss crossing the wire.

city.description: The city's name, for display; city_id is the reference.

reason.description: Shown to riders as why the price is higher.

endedAt.description: Set when staff ended it early.
